summary: linux-gate's test jobs can skip on per-crate notes: they skip when linux-gate's note or every crate's rust-tests note covers the tree, once the rust-tests policy entry is enforced (it is shadow today, so nothing changes yet)

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change; the rust-tests skip policy stays enforce false.

compatibility.detail: Required check names are unchanged. The linux-gate verdict accepts a skipped stage only when linux-gate's or rust-tests' gate decided skip and that stage's own skip rule says skip, which is the same as before for every stage while rust-tests is shadow.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; while rust-tests is shadow it has no effect.
